title: Theory of Magic Phase Transitions in Encoding-Decoding Circuits
summary: Quantum magic resources, or nonstabilizerness, are a central ingredient for universal quantum computation. In noisy many-body systems, the interplay between these resources and errors leads to sharp magic phase transitions. However, the microscopic mechanism behind these critical phenomena is still an open question, especially since early empirical evidence showed conflicting results regarding their universality classes.
